## Custom Shields.io Badges

You can create custom badges at [shields.io](https://shields.io/):

**Format:**
```
https://img.shields.io/badge/<LABEL>-<MESSAGE>-<COLOR>
```

**Examples:**
```markdown
![Privacy First](https://img.shields.io/badge/Privacy-First-brightgreen)
![Zero Telemetry](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telemetry-Zero-success)
![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-Vanilla%20JS-yellow)
![Recruiter Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Recruiter-Ready-blue)
```

---

## Embedding Badges in README

**At the top (horizontal layout):**
```markdown
<div align="center">

[![License](badge1)](link1)
[![Version](badge2)](link2)
[![Build](badge3)](link3)

</div>
```

**In sections (inline):**
```markdown
## Features
- 🛡️ Smart Sanitization ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-stable-green)
- ⚡ Lightweight ![Size](https://img.shields.io/badge/size-<5KB-brightgreen)
```

---

## Animated Badges (Optional)

Some shields support dynamic data:

```markdown
[![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Shiva-destroyer/VisualCopy/total)](https://github.com/Shiva-destroyer/VisualCopy/releases)
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Shiva-destroyer/VisualCopy)](https://github.com/Shiva-destroyer/VisualCopy/releases)
```

---

**Note:** Wait until your repository is public before adding GitHub-dependent badges (stars, forks, etc.) to avoid 404 errors.
